```js
import events from './events.json' with {type:'json'};

const issuedCursors = new Set();

function encodeCursor(index) {
  const token = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({i:index})).toString('base64');
  issuedCursors.add(token);
  return token;
}

function decodeCursor(token) {
  const json = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(token, 'base64').toString('utf8'));
  if (typeof json.i !== 'number' || !Number.isInteger(json.i)) {
    throw new Error('Invalid cursor');
  }
  return json.i;
}

export async function listTools() {
  return [
    {
      name: 'events_list',
      description: 'List events with optional cursor pagination.',
      inputSchema: {
        type: 'object',
        properties: {
          cursor: { type: 'string' },
          page_size: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: 3 }
        },
        required: [],
        additionalProperties: false
      }
    }
  ];
}

export async function callTool(name, args = {}) {
  if (name !== 'events_list') {
    throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
  }
  // validate extra fields
  const allowed = new Set(['cursor', 'page_size']);
  for (const key of Object.keys(args)) {
    if (!allowed.has(key)) {
      throw new Error(`Unknown argument: ${key}`);
    }
  }
  // page_size
  let pageSize = 2;
  if (args.page_size !== undefined) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(args.page_size) || args.page_size < 1 || args.page_size > 3) {
      throw new Error('page_size must be an integer between 1 and 3');
    }
    pageSize = args.page_size;
  }
  // cursor
  let start = 0;
  if (args.cursor !== undefined) {
    if (typeof args.cursor !== 'string') {
      throw new Error('cursor must be a string');
    }
    if (!issuedCursors.has(args.cursor)) {
      throw new Error('Unknown cursor');
    }
    start = decodeCursor(args.cursor);
  }
  const slice = events.slice(start, start + pageSize);
  const result = { events: slice };
  if (start + pageSize < events.length) {
    result.next_cursor = encodeCursor(start + pageSize);
  }
  return { content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify(result) }] };
}
```
